summary_1line: Bhishma instructs Yudhishthira on righteous kingship: choosing virtuous ministers, administering fair justice, speaking kindly, and punishing wrongdoing according to law.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged Bhishma lying on a bed of arrows instructs Yudhishthira and gathered kings about the duties of a righteous ruler.
A king seated in court listens as disputing subjects present witnesses while ministers stand beside him in solemn deliberation.
A ruler addresses his people with a calm smile and gentle words, calming angry citizens despite harsh judgments being announced.
